family.description: Self-replicating doorway/TDS dropper kit that plants identical .htaccess+index.php+cache.php triads in attacker-created directories and inside camouflaged same-named subdirectories of wp-admin/wp-includes, paired with a goto-obfuscated replacement of the WordPress root index.php and an optional loose cookie-gated remote loader at web root. First characterized from the sbkortho forensic specimen (see docs/malware-families/PG-ClonedDoorway.md).

structural.clone_triad_rule: directory basename equals parent directory basename, and directory directly contains all clone_triad_required_files

notes: known_domains and known_auth_hash_constants are supplementary exact-match bonuses tied to this specific specimen/campaign and are expected to change across deployments of this kit. They are NOT required for detection: the structural and token-level signatures in MSP_PG_ClonedDoorway_Signatures::* are the primary, deterministic, filename/variable-independent detections for this family.
